statement: Steam input visibility needs separately tested USB/HID discovery, SDL/raw-open usability, Steam managed device activation, virtual-device existence/emission, and game-specific input visibility. Raw hidraw opening or 0x83/0xae GET probes cannot alone prove managed Steam controller activation; kernel and HIDAPI enumerators issue GETs too (OpenPuck observed). Proton documents mapped virtual XInput alongside direct APIs while SDL recognizes the Linux virtual Steam pad 28de:11ff only under its explicit allow hint. This staged model is a testable interpretation, not a verified proprietary Steam 1792618285 acceptance predicate.
